summary: SQLite data-path adaptation for the official ingest pipeline: 27 analysis endpoints, 21 euro cids, 22 database bookmaker slots and 23 view slots. Mappings resolve against v_euro_snapshot, v_ah_history, v_ou_history, v_team_stats, v_bookmaker_slots, v_asian_odds and v_payload_coverage. Live fixture: data/2026-10-24/3003920.db.
limitations: This v5 is a migration snapshot from v4, not an officially evaluated evolution candidate.
Only 8 new trajectories and 6.861 days existed at build time; the official 30-trajectory / 7-day evolution gate was not reached.
188Bet has AH/OU cid 42 but no confirmed euro cid; it is marked not_offered for euro.
Poisson/Dixon-Coles score distributions are computed by the sports-math MCP; they are not stored in SQLite.
v_lineup is empty for the live fixture; lineup/formation coverage remains a data gap.
